title: Recursion and space
summary: Call trees, the call stack, output size and amortized growth.

questions.prompt: What is the time complexity of this method in terms of n?
What is the auxiliary space complexity of this method for an array of length n (count the call stack)?
What is the auxiliary space complexity of this recursive binary search (count the call stack)?
Merge sort splits the array in half, sorts each half recursively and merges them in linear time. What is its time complexity?
Why can no algorithm list every subset of n items faster than exponential time?
options: There are 2ⁿ subsets, and just writing them all out takes at least that long
Because subsets must be sorted first
It can: hashing makes it O(n)

questions.prompt: What is the total time to add n items one at a time to an initially empty ArrayList?
